```{r Load data}
# Compact helper function to read raw CSVs
read_cleaned <- function(file) {
  read.csv(file.path("..", "data", "cleaned", file),
           stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
           check.names = FALSE)
}

plant_data     <- read_cleaned("plant_data.csv")
mapp_data  <- read_cleaned("mapp_data.csv")
bee_data      <- read_cleaned("bee_data.csv")
```

# Plant data
```{r plant data Wilcoxon tests Abundance and Richness}
## Richness
# Wilcoxon test Richness overall site comparison (all visits combined)
sig_label_richness_all <- case_when(
  is.na(tryCatch(wilcox.test(richness ~ site, data = plant_data)$p.value,
                 error = function(e) NA_real_)) ~ "NA",
  tryCatch(wilcox.test(richness ~ site, data = plant_data)$p.value,
           error = function(e) NA_real_) < 0.001 ~ "***",
  tryCatch(wilcox.test(richness ~ site, data = plant_data)$p.value,
           error = function(e) NA_real_) < 0.01 ~ "**",
  tryCatch(wilcox.test(richness ~ site, data = plant_data)$p.value,
           error = function(e) NA_real_) < 0.05 ~ "*",
  tryCatch(wilcox.test(richness ~ site, data = plant_data)$p.value,
           error = function(e) NA_real_) < 0.1 ~ "°",
  TRUE ~ "ns"
)

#  Wilcoxon tests for richness per visit
wilcox_results_richness_vis <- plant_data |>
  group_by(visit) |>
  summarise(
    p_value = tryCatch(
      wilcox.test(richness ~ site)$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(sig_label = case_when(
    is.na(p_value) ~ "NA",
    p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
    p_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
    p_value < 0.1 ~ "°",
    TRUE ~ "ns"
  ))

# Wilcoxon tests for richness by region and visit
wilcox_results_richness_regvis <- plant_data |>
  group_by(region, visit) |>
  summarise(
    p_value = tryCatch(
      wilcox.test(richness ~ site)$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(sig_label = case_when(
    is.na(p_value) ~ "NA",
    p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
    p_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
    p_value < 0.1 ~ "°",
    TRUE ~ "ns"
  ))


## Relative Abundance
# Wilcoxon test for overall site comparison (all visits combined)
sig_label_abundance_all <- case_when(

  tryCatch(wilcox.test(relabundance ~ site, data = plant_data)$p.value,

)
```

```{r plant data descriptive plots Abundance and Richness}
### Richness plots
# Common y-axis limits
common_ymax_richness <- max(plant_data$richness, na.rm = TRUE)

# Richness by site type
ggplot(plant_data, aes(x = site, y = richness, fill = site)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Plant Genus Richness per Plot by Site Type",
       x = "Site Type", y = "Number of Genera (Richness)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = common_ymax_richness - 1,
           label = paste("Wilcoxon:", sig_label_richness_all),
           size = 5)

# Richenss by visit and site type
ggplot(plant_data, aes(x = factor(visit), y = richness, fill = site)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  labs(title = "Plant Genus Richness per Plot by Visit and Site Type",
       x = "Visit", y = "Number of Genera (Richness)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_text(data = wilcox_results_richness_vis,
            aes(x = factor(visit),
                y = common_ymax_richness - 1,
                label = sig_label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5)


# Richness by region, visit, and site type
```

# Habitat mapping
```{r mapp_data patchiness plot}

safe_wilcox <- function(df) {
  # Expect columns: patchiness, site
  site_levels <- unique(df$site)
  if (length(site_levels) != 2) return(NA_real_)
  # At least one non-NA per group
  gcounts <- df |>
    filter(!is.na(patchiness)) |>
    count(site) |> pull(n)
  if (length(gcounts) != 2 || any(gcounts == 0)) return(NA_real_)
  tryCatch(
    stats::wilcox.test(patchiness ~ site, data = df)$p.value,
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )
}

# Compute p-values & labels
wilcox_results_patchiness <- mapp_data |>
  group_by(region, visit) |>
  summarise(
    p_value = safe_wilcox(cur_data()),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(sig_label = case_when(
    is.na(p_value) ~ "NA",
    p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
    p_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
    p_value < 0.1 ~ "°",
    TRUE ~ "ns"
  ))

# Common ymax
common_ymax_patch <- max(mapp_data$patchiness, na.rm = TRUE)
ylab_patch <- "Patchiness"

# Region-specific plotting function
plot_region_patch <- function(reg) {
  ggplot(subset(mapp_data, region == reg),
         aes(x = factor(visit), y = patchiness, fill = site)) +
    geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge()) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(min(mapp_data$patchiness, na.rm = TRUE),
                             common_ymax_patch)) +
    labs(title = reg, x = "Visit", y = ylab_patch) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("focal" = "#1b9e77", "control" = "#d95f02")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    geom_text(
      data = subset(wilcox_results_patchiness, region == reg),
      aes(x = factor(visit),
          y = common_ymax_patch - 0.05 *
            (common_ymax_patch - min(mapp_data$patchiness, na.rm = TRUE)),
          label = sig_label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5
    )
}

regions_to_plot <- c("Aire", "Scheulte", "Thiele", "Schwarzbach")
plots <- map(regions_to_plot, plot_region_patch)

patchiness_patchwork <- (plots[[1]] | plots[[2]]) / (plots[[3]] | plots[[4]])
patchiness_patchwork
```


# Bee data
```{r bee data overview numbers}
# total species count
total_species <- length(which(names(bee_data) == "Andrena aeneiventris")
                        :which(names(bee_data) == "Stelis punctulatissima"))

# Derive species column block by names (robust to column reordering)
start <- match("Andrena aeneiventris", names(bee_data))
end   <- match("Stelis punctulatissima", names(bee_data))
species_cols <- start:end

# Logical presence (>=1) per site type
control_pres <- colSums(bee_data[bee_data$site == "control",
                                 species_cols] > 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
focal_pres   <- colSums(bee_data[bee_data$site == "focal",
                                 species_cols] > 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0

# Number of Bee species by site
sum(control_pres)
sum(focal_pres)
```

Accumulation curve
```{r species accumulation curve}

p_accumsite <- function() {
  # --- 1. Define metadata columns to exclude ---
  meta_cols <- c(
    "surveyID", "plotID", "site", "region", "visit", "plot",
    "fieldIDsum", "bee_richness", "bee_abundance_nofieldID", "bee_abundance",
    "bee_hill_q1", "bee_hill_q2",
    "RLabund_LC", "RLabund_NT", "RLabund_VU", "RLabund_EN", "RLabund_DD",
    "RLrich_LC", "RLrich_NT", "RLrich_VU", "RLrich_EN", "RLrich_DD",
    "RLrich_CR", "RLabund_CR",
    "RLrich_threatened", "RLabund_threatened",
    "RLrich_total", "RLabund_total"
  )

  # --- 2. Keep only species matrix ---
  bee_matrix <- bee_data |>
    select(-all_of(meta_cols))

  # Safety checks
  stopifnot(all(sapply(bee_matrix, is.numeric)))
  stopifnot(ncol(bee_matrix) > 0)

  # --- 3. Split by treatment ---
  bee_matrix_control <- bee_matrix[bee_data$site == "control", ]
  bee_matrix_focal   <- bee_matrix[bee_data$site == "focal",   ]

  # --- 5. Run accumulation ---
  bee_accum_control <- specaccum(bee_matrix_control, method = "random")
  bee_accum_focal   <- specaccum(bee_matrix_focal,   method = "random")

  # --- 6. Colors ---
  site_cols <- list(
    focal   = "#2C7FB8",
    control = "#D95F09"
  )

  site_cols$focal_light   <- adjustcolor(site_cols$focal,   alpha.f = 0.25)
  site_cols$control_light <- adjustcolor(site_cols$control, alpha.f = 0.25)

  # --- 7. Compute Y limits safely ---
  ylim_all <- range(
    c(bee_accum_control$richness - bee_accum_control$sd,
      bee_accum_control$richness + bee_accum_control$sd,
      bee_accum_focal$richness   - bee_accum_focal$sd,
      bee_accum_focal$richness   + bee_accum_focal$sd),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  # --- 8. Plot control ---
  plot(bee_accum_control,
       xlab = "Number of surveys (plot visits)",
       ylab = "Accumulated species richness",
       main = "Species Accumulation: Control vs Focal Sites",
       ci.type = "polygon",
       col    = site_cols$control,
       lwd    = 2,
       ci.col = site_cols$control_light,
       ci.lty = 0,
       ylim   = ylim_all)

  # --- 9. Add focal ---
  plot(bee_accum_focal,
       add    = TRUE,
       col    = site_cols$focal,
       lwd    = 2,
       ci.type = "polygon",
       ci.col = site_cols$focal_light,
       ci.lty = 0)

  # --- 10. Legend ---
  legend("bottomright",
         legend = c("Control", "Focal"),
         col    = c(site_cols$control, site_cols$focal),
         lwd    = 2,
         bty    = "n")
}

p_accumsite()
```

Species accumulation curve by region per site type
```{r}
p_accumregion <- function() {
  # --- 1. Metadata ---
  meta_cols <- c(
    "surveyID", "plotID", "site", "region", "visit", "plot",
    "fieldIDsum", "bee_richness", "bee_abundance_nofieldID", "bee_abundance",
    "bee_hill_q1", "bee_hill_q2",
    "RLabund_LC", "RLabund_NT", "RLabund_VU", "RLabund_EN", "RLabund_DD",
    "RLrich_LC", "RLrich_NT", "RLrich_VU", "RLrich_EN", "RLrich_DD",
    "RLrich_CR", "RLabund_CR",
    "RLrich_threatened", "RLabund_threatened",
    "RLrich_total", "RLabund_total"
  )

  # --- 2. Species matrix ---
  bee_matrix <- bee_data |>
    select(-all_of(meta_cols))

  # --- 3. Colors ---
  site_cols <- list(
    focal   = "#2C7FB8",
    control = "#D95F09"
  )

  site_cols$focal_light   <- adjustcolor(site_cols$focal,   alpha.f = 0.25)
  site_cols$control_light <- adjustcolor(site_cols$control, alpha.f = 0.25)

  # --- 4. Regions ---
  regions <- unique(bee_data$region)

  # --- 5. 4-panel layout ---
  par(mfrow = c(2, 2), mar = c(4, 4, 3, 1))

  # --- 6. Loop over regions ---
  for (reg in regions) {

    # subset data
    idx_region <- bee_data$region == reg

    mat_region <- bee_matrix[idx_region, ]
    site_region <- bee_data$site[idx_region]

    # split by site
    mat_control <- mat_region[site_region == "control", ]
    mat_focal   <- mat_region[site_region == "focal", ]

    # safety check
    if (nrow(mat_control) == 0 | nrow(mat_focal) == 0) {
      plot.new()
      title(main = paste(reg, "(no data)"))
      next
    }

    # accumulation
    acc_control <- specaccum(mat_control, method = "random")
    acc_focal   <- specaccum(mat_focal,   method = "random")

    # shared y-axis limits per panel
    ylim_all <- range(
      c(acc_control$richness - acc_control$sd,
        acc_control$richness + acc_control$sd,
        acc_focal$richness   - acc_focal$sd,
        acc_focal$richness   + acc_focal$sd),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    # plot control
    plot(acc_control,
         xlab = "Number of surveys",
         ylab = "Accumulated richness",
         main = reg,
         col = site_cols$control,
         lwd = 2,
         ci.type = "polygon",
         ci.col = site_cols$control_light,
         ci.lty = 0,
         ylim = ylim_all)

    # add focal
    plot(acc_focal,
         add = TRUE,
         col = site_cols$focal,
         lwd = 2,
         ci.type = "polygon",
         ci.col = site_cols$focal_light,
         ci.lty = 0)

    # legend inside each panel
    legend("bottomright",
           legend = c("Control", "Focal"),
           col = c(site_cols$control, site_cols$focal),
           lwd = 2,
           bty = "n",
           cex = 0.8)
  }
}

p_accumregion()
```


```{r bee data wilcoxon tests}
# Bee species richness - run Wilcoxon test across all visits and regions
wilcox_beeri_all <- wilcox.test(bee_richness ~ site, data = bee_data)

sig_label_beeri_all <- case_when(
  wilcox_beeri_all$p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
  wilcox_beeri_all$p.value < 0.01 ~ "**",
  wilcox_beeri_all$p.value < 0.05 ~ "*",
  TRUE ~ "ns"
)

# Bee species richness - run Wilcoxon test per visit across all regions
wilcox_beeri_by_visit <- bee_data |>
  group_by(visit) |>
  summarise(p_value = tryCatch(
    wilcox.test(bee_richness ~ site)$p.value,
    error = function(e) NA_real_),
    sig_label = case_when(
      is.na(p_value) ~ "NA",
      p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
      p_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
      p_value < 0.1 ~ ".",
      TRUE ~ "ns"),
    label = paste0(sig_label, "\n(p = ", round(p_value, 3), ")"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Bee species richness - run Wilcoxon tests for each region and visit
wilcox_results_beeri <- bee_data |>
  group_by(region, visit) |>
  summarise(
    n_focal = sum(site == "focal"),
    n_control = sum(site == "control"),
    p_value = if (n_focal >= 1 & n_control >= 1) {
      tryCatch(
        wilcox.test(bee_richness ~ site)$p.value,
        error = function(e) NA_real_
      )
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

wilcox_results_beeri <- wilcox_results_beeri |>
  mutate(sig_label = case_when(
    is.na(p_value) ~ "NA",
    p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
    p_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
    p_value < 0.1 ~ ".",
    TRUE ~ "ns"
  ))

# Bee abundance - run Wilcoxon test across all visits and regions
wilcox_beeab_all <- wilcox.test(bee_abundance ~ site, data = bee_data)

sig_label_beeab_all <- case_when(
  wilcox_beeab_all$p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
  wilcox_beeab_all$p.value < 0.01 ~ "**",
  wilcox_beeab_all$p.value < 0.05 ~ "*",
  TRUE ~ "ns"
)

# Bee abundance - run Wilcoxon test per visit across all regions
wilcox_beeab_by_visit <- bee_data |>
  group_by(visit) |>
  summarise(
    p_value = tryCatch(
      wilcox.test(bee_abundance ~ site)$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_),
    sig_label = case_when(
      is.na(p_value) ~ "NA",
      p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
      p_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
      p_value < 0.1 ~ ".",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    ),
    label = paste0(sig_label, "\n(p = ", round(p_value, 3), ")"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Bee abudnance - run Wilcoxon tests for each region and visit
wilcox_results_beeab <- bee_data |>
  group_by(region, visit) |>
  summarise(
    n_focal = sum(site == "focal"),
    n_control = sum(site == "control"),
    p_value = if (n_focal >= 1 & n_control >= 1) {
      tryCatch(
        wilcox.test(bee_abundance ~ site)$p.value,
        error = function(e) NA_real_
      )
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

wilcox_results_beeab <- wilcox_results_beeab |>
  mutate(sig_label = case_when(
    is.na(p_value) ~ "NA",
    p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
    p_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
    p_value < 0.1 ~ ".",
    TRUE ~ "ns"
  ))
```

```{r bee Red List Wilcoxon & plots}
# Wilcoxon test across all visits & sites (paired)
wilcox_rlrich_all <- wilcox.test(
  bee_data$RLrich_threatened,
  bee_data$RLrich_total - bee_data$RLrich_threatened,
  paired = TRUE
)

sig_label_rlrich_all <- case_when(
  wilcox_rlrich_all$p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
  wilcox_rlrich_all$p.value < 0.01 ~ "**",
  wilcox_rlrich_all$p.value < 0.05 ~ "*",
  wilcox_rlrich_all$p.value < 0.1 ~ ".",
  TRUE ~ "ns"
)

# Prepare long format for plotting
rl_plotdata_rich <- bee_data |>
  mutate(RLrich_non_threatened = RLrich_total - RLrich_threatened) |>
  select(surveyID, site, region, visit, RLrich_threatened, RLrich_non_threatened) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("RLrich_"),
               names_to = "RL_category",
               values_to = "value")

# Plot RL richness
ggplot(rl_plotdata_rich, aes(x = factor(visit), y = value, fill = RL_category)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  facet_wrap(~site) +
  labs(
    title = "Red List Bee Richness (Threatened vs Non-threatened)",
    x = "Visit",
    y = "Number of Species",
    fill = "Category"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "RLrich_threatened" = "#d95f02",
    "RLrich_non_threatened" = "#1b9e77"
  )) +
  theme_minimal() +
  annotate("text",
           x = 1.5, y = max(rl_plotdata_rich$value, na.rm = TRUE) - 1,
           label = paste("Wilcoxon:", sig_label_rlrich_all),
           size = 5)


# RL Abundance: Threatened vs Non-threatened

)

  wilcox_rlabund_all$p.value < 0.05 ~ "*",
  wilcox_rlabund_all$p.value < 0.1 ~ ".",
  TRUE ~ "ns"
)

# RL Richness per region & visit
wilcox_results_rlrich <- bee_data |>
  mutate(RLrich_non_threatened = RLrich_total - RLrich_threatened) |>
  group_by(region, visit) |>
  summarise(
    p_value = tryCatch(
      wilcox.test(RLrich_threatened, RLrich_non_threatened, paired = TRUE)$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(sig_label = case_when(
    is.na(p_value) ~ "NA",
    p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
    p_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
    p_value < 0.1 ~ ".",
    TRUE ~ "ns"
  ))

  mutate(RLrich_non_threatened = RLrich_total - RLrich_threatened) |>
  select(surveyID, site, region, visit, RLrich_threatened, RLrich_non_threatened) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("RLrich_"),
               names_to = "RL_category",
               values_to = "value")

common_ymax_rlrich <- max(rl_plotdata_rich$value, na.rm = TRUE)

  geom_text(data = wilcox_results_rlrich,
```

```{r species accumulation by site}
# Species matrix (clean)
start <- match("Andrena aeneiventris", names(bee_data))
end   <- match("Stelis punctulatissima", names(bee_data))
bee_matrix <- bee_data[, start:end]

# Optional but recommended
bee_matrix[is.na(bee_matrix)] <- 0

# Split by site
mat_control <- bee_matrix[bee_data$site == "control", ]
mat_focal   <- bee_matrix[bee_data$site == "focal",   ]

# Safety checks
if (nrow(mat_control) < 2 | nrow(mat_focal) < 2) {
  stop("Not enough data for one of the site types.")
}

if (sum(mat_control) == 0 | sum(mat_focal) == 0) {
  stop("One site type has no species records.")
}

# Accumulation curves
acc_control <- specaccum(mat_control, method = "random")
acc_focal   <- specaccum(mat_focal,   method = "random")

# Y axis
ymax <- max(
  acc_control$richness + acc_control$sd,
  acc_focal$richness   + acc_focal$sd,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

if (!is.finite(ymax)) {
  stop("Invalid ymax (check data)")
}

# Colors
col_control <- "#2C7FB8"
col_focal   <- "#D95F09"

# Plot
plot(acc_control,
     xlab = "Number of surveys (plot visits)",
     ylab = "Accumulated species richness",
     main = "Species Accumulation: Control vs Focal",
     ci.type = "polygon",
     col    = col_control,
     ci.col = adjustcolor(col_control, 0.3),
     lwd    = 2,
     ylim   = c(0, ymax))

plot(acc_focal,
     add = TRUE,
     col    = col_focal,
     ci.col = adjustcolor(col_focal, 0.3),
     ci.type = "polygon",
     lwd    = 2)

legend("bottomright",
       legend = c("Control", "Focal"),
       col    = c(col_control, col_focal),
       lwd    = 2,
       bty    = "n")
```
```{r accumulatin curve by site and region}
# Species matrix (safe + clean)
start <- match("Andrena aeneiventris", names(bee_data))
end   <- match("Stelis punctulatissima", names(bee_data))
bee_matrix <- bee_data[, start:end]
bee_matrix[is.na(bee_matrix)] <- 0

# Regions
regions <- unique(bee_data$region)

# Layout (adjust rows/cols depending on number of regions)
par(mfrow = c(ceiling(length(regions)/2), 2))

for (r in regions) {

  # Subset region
  idx <- bee_data$region == r
  mat_region <- bee_matrix[idx, ]
  site_region <- bee_data$site[idx]

  mat_control <- mat_region[site_region == "control", ]
  mat_focal   <- mat_region[site_region == "focal",   ]

  # Skip problematic regions
  if (nrow(mat_control) < 2 || nrow(mat_focal) < 2) {
    plot.new()
    title(main = paste(r, "(insufficient data)"))
    next
  }

  if (sum(mat_control) == 0 || sum(mat_focal) == 0) {
    plot.new()
    title(main = paste(r, "(no species data)"))
    next
  }

  # Accumulation curves
  acc_control <- specaccum(mat_control, method = "random")
  acc_focal   <- specaccum(mat_focal,   method = "random")

  # Y limit
  ymax <- max(
    acc_control$richness + acc_control$sd,
    acc_focal$richness   + acc_focal$sd,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  if (!is.finite(ymax)) {
    plot.new()
    title(main = paste(r, "(invalid data)"))
    next
  }

  # Colors
  col_control <- "#2C7FB8"
  col_focal   <- "#D95F09"

  # Plot control
  plot(acc_control,
       xlab = "Number of surveys",
       ylab = "Accumulated species richness",
       main = r,
       ci.type = "polygon",
       col    = col_control,
       ci.col = adjustcolor(col_control, 0.3),
       lwd    = 2,
       ylim   = c(0, ymax))

  # Add focal
  plot(acc_focal,
       add = TRUE,
       col    = col_focal,
       ci.col = adjustcolor(col_focal, 0.3),
       ci.type = "polygon",
       lwd    = 2)

  # Legend
  legend("bottomright",
         legend = c("Control", "Focal"),
         col    = c(col_control, col_focal),
         lwd    = 2,
         bty    = "n",
         cex    = 0.9)
}

# Reset layout
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

```{r bee curve species richness by number collected}
# Species matrix
start <- match("Andrena aeneiventris", names(bee_data))
end   <- match("Stelis punctulatissima", names(bee_data))
bee_matrix <- bee_data[, start:end]
bee_matrix[is.na(bee_matrix)] <- 0

# Split
mat_control <- bee_matrix[bee_data$site == "control", ]
mat_focal   <- bee_matrix[bee_data$site == "focal",   ]

# Totals
N_control <- sum(mat_control)
N_focal   <- sum(mat_focal)

# Permutations
n_perm <- 200
set.seed(123)

# control
vec_control <- rep(colnames(mat_control), colSums(mat_control))
acc_control <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_perm, ncol = N_control)

for (p in 1:n_perm) {
  indiv <- sample(vec_control)
  acc_control[p, ] <- cumsum(!duplicated(indiv))
}

# focal
vec_focal <- rep(colnames(mat_focal), colSums(mat_focal))
acc_focal <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_perm, ncol = N_focal)

for (p in 1:n_perm) {
  indiv <- sample(vec_focal)
  acc_focal[p, ] <- cumsum(!duplicated(indiv))
}

# Mean + CI
mean_control <- colMeans(acc_control)
mean_focal   <- colMeans(acc_focal)

lower_control <- apply(acc_control, 2, quantile, 0.025)

upper_control <- apply(acc_control, 2, quantile, 0.975)

lower_focal <- apply(acc_focal, 2, quantile, 0.025)
upper_focal <- apply(acc_focal, 2, quantile, 0.975)

# X axes
x_control <- 1:N_control
x_focal   <- 1:N_focal

# Colors
col_control <- "#2C7FB8"
col_focal   <- "#D95F09"

# Plot limits
xmax <- max(N_control, N_focal)
ymax <- max(upper_control, upper_focal)

# ---- PLOT ----
plot(0, 0,
     type = "n",
     xlim = c(0, xmax),
     ylim = c(0, ymax),
     xlab = "Number of bees (individuals)",
     ylab = "Accumulated species richness",
     main = "Species accumulation by individuals")

# Control ribbon
polygon(c(x_control, rev(x_control)),
        c(upper_control, rev(lower_control)),
        col = adjustcolor(col_control, 0.25),
        border = NA)

# Focal ribbon
polygon(c(x_focal, rev(x_focal)),
        c(upper_focal, rev(lower_focal)),
        col = adjustcolor(col_focal, 0.25),
        border = NA)

# Lines
lines(x_control, mean_control, col = col_control, lwd = 2.5)
lines(x_focal,   mean_focal,   col = col_focal,   lwd = 2.5)

# Legend
legend("bottomright",
       legend = c(
         paste0("Control (n=", N_control, ")"),
         paste0("Focal (n=", N_focal, ")")
       ),
       col = c(col_control, col_focal),
       lwd = 2.5,
       bty = "n")
```

```{r NMDS bee communities by region and site}
# Species matrix indices
start <- match("Andrena aeneiventris", names(bee_data))
end   <- match("Stelis punctulatissima", names(bee_data))
species_cols <- start:end

regions <- unique(bee_data$region)

for (r in regions) {

  # Subset region
  dat <- bee_data |> filter(region == r)
  
  # Pool plots within site × visit
  dat_pool <- dat |>
    group_by(site, visit) |>
    summarise(across(all_of(names(bee_data)[species_cols]), sum), .groups = "drop")

  # Community matrix
  comm <- as.matrix(dat_pool[, names(bee_data)[species_cols]])

  # NMDS
  nmds <- metaMDS(comm, distance = "bray", k = 2, trymax = 100)

  # Plot
  plot(nmds, type = "n", main = paste("NMDS –", r))

  # Colors
  cols <- ifelse(dat_pool$site == "control", "#2C7FB8", "#D95F09")

  points(nmds, col = cols, pch = 19)

  # Optional: group ellipses
  ordiellipse(nmds, dat_pool$site,
              col = c("#2C7FB8", "#D95F09"),
              lwd = 2)

  legend("topright",
         legend = c("Control", "Focal"),
         col = c("#2C7FB8", "#D95F09"),
         pch = 19,
         bty = "n")
}
```
